prompt:
Write a React TypeScript `PinInputCode` component with `length?: number` (default 4), `value: string`, `onChange: (val: string) => void`. Render `length` number of text inputs with `aria-label="Digit {i+1}"`. Entering a digit should automatically advance focus to the next input, and pressing Backspace on an empty input should focus the previous input.
IMPORTANT: Export the component as a named export called `PinInputCode`.

Write a React TypeScript `NumericStepperInput` component with `value: number`, `min?: number`, `max?: number`, `step?: number` (default 1), `onChange: (val: number) => void`. Render decrement and increment buttons with accessible labels `aria-label="Decrement"` and `aria-label="Increment"`, plus a text/number display with `role="spinbutton"` and `aria-valuenow`. Buttons must be disabled when min or max is reached.
IMPORTANT: Export the component as a named export called `NumericStepperInput`.

Write a React TypeScript `PasswordChecklist` component with `password: string`. Check for 4 rules: 8+ characters, at least 1 uppercase letter, at least 1 number, at least 1 special character. Render an accessible list `role="list"` with each requirement `role="listitem"`. Display a checkmark or indicator and set `data-valid="true"` or `data-valid="false"` on each item.
IMPORTANT: Export the component as a named export called `PasswordChecklist`.

Write a React TypeScript `ChipFilterGroup` component with `options: string[]`, `selected: string[]`, `onChange: (selected: string[]) => void`. Render a group container `role="group"` containing toggleable chip buttons. Each chip button should set `aria-pressed="true"` when selected and toggle inclusion in `selected` on click.
IMPORTANT: Export the component as a named export called `ChipFilterGroup`.

Write a React TypeScript `FileInputPreview` component with `accept?: string`, `onFilesSelected: (files: File[]) => void`. Render a file input or drag target. When files are selected or passed via props, display each filename in a list with a remove button `aria-label="Remove {filename}"`.
IMPORTANT: Export the component as a named export called `FileInputPreview`.

IMPORTANT: Export the component as a named export called `OptionCardGroup`.
